text_block_list.name: Kind Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Alve-san...! I have some recommended 
care products, if you'd like—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No. I know when it tends to flare up. 
I've already prepared the right care 
products for each cause.

text_block_list.name: Kind Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so... Impressive as always.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...I'll need to treat this once I'm back 
in my room.)
